# google_cloud_support_support_event_subscription

A support event subscription for receiving notifications from Cloud Support API.



## Example Usage - Cloud Support Event Subscription Basic


```hcl
resource "google_project_service" "cloudsupport" {
  project            = "my-project-name"
  service            = "cloudsupport.googleapis.com"
  disable_on_destroy = false
}

resource "google_pubsub_topic" "support_topic" {
  project = "my-project-name"
  name    = "test-topic-%{random_suffix}"
}

resource "google_pubsub_topic_iam_member" "support_publisher" {
  project = "my-project-name"
  topic   = google_pubsub_topic.support_topic.id
  role    = "roles/pubsub.publisher"
  member  = "serviceAccount:cloud-support-apievents@system.gserviceaccount.com"
}

resource "google_cloud_support_support_event_subscription" "subscription" {
  organization  = "123456789"
  pub_sub_topic = google_pubsub_topic.support_topic.id

  depends_on = [
    google_project_service.cloudsupport,
    google_pubsub_topic_iam_member.support_publisher,
  ]
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `pub_sub_topic` -
  (Required)
  The name of the Pub/Sub topic to publish notifications to.
  Format: projects/{project}/topics/{topic}

* `organization` -
  (Required)
  The organization ID for the support event subscription.


* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `organizations/{{organization}}/supportEventSubscriptions/{{name}}`

* `create_time` -
  The time at which the subscription was created.

* `delete_time` -
  The time at which the subscription was deleted.

* `failure_reason` -
  Reason why subscription is failing. State of subscription
  must be FAILING in order for this to have a value.
  Possible values:
  PERMISSION_DENIED
  TOPIC_NOT_FOUND
  OTHER

* `name` -
  Identifier. The resource name of the support event subscription.

* `purge_time` -
  The time at which the subscription will be purged.

* `state` -
  The state of the subscription.
  Possible values:
  WORKING
  FAILING
  DELETED

* `update_time` -
  The time at which the subscription was last updated.

* `organizations/{{organization}}/supportEventSubscriptions/{{name}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import SupportEventSubscription using identity values. For example:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import SupportEventSubscription using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf

  id = "organizations/{{organization}}/supportEventSubscriptions/{{name}}"
```
